Other characters who die in A Path of Daggers are listed as having died in 998. I'd forgotten- does the timeframe of the novel really cover 2 whole years, 998-1000? [[User:Eschiss1|Eschiss1]] ([[User talk:Eschiss1|talk]]) 19:21, February 26, 2018 (UTC)




Yes.  As absurd as it sometimes seems, the timeframe of the 14 core novels only spans 2.5 years.  From late winter/early spring of 998 NE in [[The Eye of the World]] to late Autumn/early winter of 1000 NE in [[A Memory of Light]].  I've frequently reflected on how [[Robert Jordan]] never quite thought through the pacing of the general storyline.

As for characters dying in [[The Path of Daggers]], to be correct in the wiki they should be listed as perishing in early 1000 NE.
